items.title: American Doctor
items.overview: United by a shared oath to save lives, three American doctors—Palestinian, Jewish, and Zoroastrian—work in a besieged hospital in Gaza in the middle of a genocide comitted by Israel, and return to the United States to fight for the patients and colleagues they left behind.

items.title: Don't Say Good Luck
items.overview: Sophie Birenbaum is ready for the spotlight as the lead in her high school musical—until she's suddenly facing more drama at home than on the stage.

items.title: Once Upon a Time in the Middle East
items.overview: Seeking a fresh start, chef Xu Fu travels to the Middle East to support his family and repay his debts. Alongside restaurant manager Ma Junsheng, he transforms the struggling Dragon Restaurant into a thriving business. But when war engulfs the city, their hard-won success is shattered and the restaurant becomes a refuge for those caught in the conflict. As danger closes in, Xu Fu must risk everything to protect his newfound community and preserve a small beacon of hope amid the devastation.

items.title: Bethlehem Kudumba Unit
items.overview: Ashley's homecoming from abroad takes an emotional turn when a wedding next door stirs memories of her first love, Justin.

items.title: Call My Agent! The Movie
items.overview: Five years after ASK Agency closed, debut director Andréa loses her lead actor just days before filming and reunited with her old team — for better or worse.

items.title: Modha Rathri
items.overview: Two strangers are brought together at an unusual wedding where, in one night, too many surprises unfold and several lies are told, spiraling into chaos that changes everything.

items.title: Adored
items.overview: After a devastating personal tragedy, an A-list actress retreats to a secluded island villa. But she's not alone....

items.title: Everytime
items.overview: A tragedy brings a mother, daughter, and teenage boy together. Struggling with blame and forgiveness, the unlikely trio take a trip to Tenerife for a family holiday that never happened. Under the glow of the sun, past and present quietly start to overlap.

items.title: Before Never
items.overview: When Wendy Darling escapes an attempted abduction, her family employs James and Smee to identify the attacker with the help of the only eyewitness: Peter Pan.

items.title: Novak Djokovic: The Wolf in Winter
items.overview: He's conquered every title in tennis, including an Olympic gold. So why is Novak Djokovic still playing? The Wolf in Winter embeds with the greatest tennis player of all time as he returned to the Australian Open in 2025, capturing the obsession, the preparation, and the fire that won't go out even when there's nothing left to prove.

items.title: Freefall: A Reckoning for Boeing
items.overview: Following the highly publicized death of Boeing whistleblower John Barnett, the investigation continues into the once-iconic aviation giant, uncovering startling new revelations and insider accounts in the wake of a deepening corporate crisis..

items.title: Coyote vs. Acme
items.overview: After Acme products fail him one too many times in his dogged pursuit of the Roadrunner, Wile E. Coyote decides to hire a billboard lawyer to sue the Acme Corporation.

items.title: The Sun Never Sets
items.overview: While on an unexpected break from her older, divorced boyfriend, a woman runs into her ex-partner, plunging her into a volatile love triangle that threatens to undo her life.

items.title: Tony
items.overview: A 19-year-old Anthony Bourdain travels to Provincetown and stumbles into the chaotic world of a restaurant kitchen, setting off a summer that will shape the course of his life.

items.title: The End of Oak Street
items.overview: After a mysterious cosmic event rips Oak Street from suburbia and transports their neighborhood to someplace unknown, the Platt family soon discovers that their very survival depends on them sticking together as they navigate their now unrecognizable surroundings.

items.title: V
items.overview: In the early 1990s, this city of desire, once a land of opportunity, was plagued by rampant crime and a breakdown of order. Man Tsz-keung, a working-class man desperate to change his fate, meets flight attendant Lok Ka-yuen, and the two team up to rob a large sum of money. This success fuels Man Tsz-keung's madness, pushing him into a deeper power struggle with wealthy businessman Chan Fai-yin. Meanwhile, mainland police officer Qi Honggang and Hong Kong police officer Guan Suchen continue their investigation of Wan Ziqiang, leading to a joint operation between the two police forces, setting the stage for a clash between good and evil. This film is fictional.

items.title: Yellow Mirror
items.overview: A defective lamp reveals a heartbreaking truth about what Homer believes is reality, and an AI-powered tablet befriends and controls Maggie. The Simpsons struggle to find the light through two dark tales of the curious and bizarre.

items.title: DC
items.overview: From avenging his mother’s murder to battling police corruption, Das becomes a fugitive after a deadly heist. Amid a trail of bloodshed and loss, he frees Chandra from a life of exploitation, and she gives him a reason to seek a life beyond violence.

items.title: Buddy
items.overview: Inside the colorful world of "It's Buddy!", a group of children spend their days singing, dancing, and helping Buddy - bright orange unicorn - spread happiness. But when one child refuses to play along, Buddy is not pleased and cracks begin to appear in this seemingly perfect world.

items.title: Camp Rock 3
items.overview: When pop group Connect 3 returns to Camp Rock to search for an opening act for their reunion tour, rising tensions and fierce competition among campers test old friendships and spark unexpected romances.

items.title: Teenage Sex and Death at Camp Miasma
items.overview: An ambitious director sets out to revive a faded slasher franchise, but her meeting with the film’s reclusive original star spirals into a terrifying maze of obsession, fear, and blood-soaked delusion.

items.title: The Parking Spot
items.overview: A quarrel over a parking space pulls a couple into an unexpected confrontation with a stranger.

items.title: Hanuman Ansh
items.overview: A grieving boy seeks God to meet his departed mother, and in finding the divine, learns to serve humanity with miracles of love, food and silent blessings, becoming Hanuman Ansh, Neem Karoli Baba.

items.title: Facing El Chapo
items.overview: Two Mexican officers must survive the final hours of their shift after crossing a ruthless cartel boss.

items.title: Storm on Sesame Street
items.overview: As a big storm approaches, Elmo and friends work together to get ready. After it passes, Sesame Street looks different — and everyone pitches in to help.

items.title: Tad and The Magic Lamp
items.overview: Tadeo, his girlfriend Sara, and his friends Momia, Jeff, and Belzoni embark on an adventure after Tadeo accidentally unleashes an ancient spell.

items.title: The Rivals of Amziah King
items.overview: Deep within the backwoods of rural Oklahoma, charismatic and musically gifted Amziah King herds a bluegrass-playing band of misfits while overseeing the premier honey-making operation in town. When Amziah’s estranged foster daughter unexpectedly returns, Amziah leaps at the possibility to renew connection and create a family business. But the honey game is ruthless, and Amziah’s rivals threaten to destroy everything he has built.

items.title: Vishwanath & Sons
items.overview: A celebrated Olympian shooter travels to America looking for a donor to help his sick child — but unexpected romance complicates his search.

items.title: Barreda
items.overview: A fictionalized drama film based on one of the most shocking crimes in Argentina's history. In 1992, Ricardo Barreda was an unassuming dentist, brutally murdered his wife, mother-in-law, and two adult daughters in their family home. Branding himself as a victim, Ricardo Barreda ignited a media storm and fueled a national scandal.

items.title: Insidious: Out of the Further
items.overview: Gemma, a young mother raising her daughter in the house she grew up in, discovers she can travel into The Further, where she possesses an ability to bring what lives there back to the real world.

items.title: Late Fame
items.overview: At the very end of the 1970s, post office worker Ed Saxberger wrote a book of poetry that nobody cared about. After an eager and flattering fan appears on his doorstep, Saxberger is beckoned into a coterie of young admirers who anoint him a rediscovered genius. The group of downtown bohemians is led by their "tragic heroine," Gloria. Intoxicated by the attention, and Gloria's alluring presence, Saxberger gradually reckons with the authenticity of his newfound poetic circle.

items.title: Sex Drive
items.overview: Sheltered Sasha joins her uninhibited best friend Kelly on a getaway, but rescuing an amnesiac man turns their sexy escape into a deadly game of truth and deception.

items.title: Donkey Princess
items.overview: Diana is the princess of an ancient kingdom. Her father, King Arthur, forbids love. When Diana falls in love with Lalo, he banishes him. Using a magical bracelet, Diana travels to other worlds in search of her love.

items.title: It Ends
items.overview: A group of recent grads head out on a late night drive for grub, hoping to enjoy one final hangout before their paths diverge. Instead, they accidentally turn onto a never-ending, two-lane hellscape surrounded by untold horrors and cosmic forces beyond their understanding. Cramped together inside a Jeep Cherokee and with the miles stretching infinitely ahead, they face a choice: embrace their new existence or fight to escape it.

items.title: The Brink of War
items.overview: President Ronald Reagan races against time to salvage a deal with Soviet leader Mikhail Gorbachev that could dismantle nuclear arsenals—or ignite disaster. With pressure mounting on all sides, every word spoken brings the world closer to peace... or destruction.

items.title: LEGO Disney Princess: Magical Mayhem
items.overview: During a heavy rainstorm, the Princess characters and their sidekick friends take in animals in need while enjoying a cozy day in their castle. But when the animals run amok, chaos erupts. Sleuthing reveals a mischievous villain behind it all, and with teamwork, quick thinking, and help from an unexpected friend, the Princess characters must restore order and save their home.

items.title: Nimrods
items.overview: Three friends journey from Kansas City to Los Angeles, mistakenly believing that their band is opening for Green Day on New Year’s Eve.

items.title: Puella Magi Madoka Magica the Movie -Walpurgisnacht: Rising-
items.overview: After the events of Rebellion, the world appears to be in balance—but that peace is fragile. As a new threat connected to Walpurgisnacht emerges, Homura Akemi is forced to face the consequences of her choices and question how far she is willing to go to protect Madoka.

items.title: My Best Friend, His Girlfriend and Me
items.overview: Olli and Matze are best friends living, working and planning to travel the world together — until Matze's romance with Rebecca turns it all upside down.

items.title: Mutiny
items.overview: After witnessing his billionaire boss' murder and being framed for the crime, Cole Reed boards a cargo ship on a one-man crusade to avenge his boss' death only to discover an international conspiracy.

items.title: The Dog Stars
items.overview: After the world's population has been ravaged by a pandemic, a man lives a lonesome existence in a Colorado airplane hangar with his dog and a dour gunman he has befriended. When a mysterious transmission comes through on the radio while he’s flying his old Cessna, it sparks a hunt for the provenance of the sound.

items.title: Super Troopers 3
items.overview: When Farva’s wildly over-the-top Indian engagement to Thorny’s sister spirals into chaos, the Super Troopers must navigate Thorny’s schemes to break up the relationship, while trying to crack a pernicious new drug ring  — all to save the day and maybe the wedding itself.

items.title: One Night Only
items.overview: Two love-starved strangers crash into each other on the one night of the year when single people are allowed to have sex.

items.title: Idiots
items.overview: Two rock-bottom drivers transport a wealthy teen to rehab, but their simple job spirals into a chaotic journey of drugs, danger, and crime as their passenger derails their plans.

items.title: Awarapan 2
items.overview: Once a feared gangster, Shivam lives hidden away from his past, with no faith left in God or himself. But when fate pulls him into Bangkok's cartel war and forces him back into the darkness he swore never to return to, Shivam must choose what he is willing to live for, when there is nothing left to lose.

items.title: The Last Scene
items.overview: Selen is a woman with the extraordinary ability to foresee other people’s futures in her dreams. Determined to use this gift to change her own life and the fate of those around her, she unexpectedly finds herself drawn into a dangerous love story. When she crosses paths with a man, Kemal, their connection sparks both passion and peril, forcing Selen to make choices that will shape both of their destinies.

items.title: Rage of Stars
items.overview: A story about a woman from the International Special Forces Unit, who has a premonition about the impending end of humanity.

items.title: Meteor Extinction
items.overview: A planet-destroying meteor is heading straight for Earth. Nothing we haven’t seen before. NASA uses a laser to destroy it. The day is saved… until it’s revealed that the comet was made entirely of an element that when heated up (in this case by laser) turns into molten magma in the sky, and there is enough of it to cover the entire planet in this hyper-heated coating and destroy the world. Liquid being impervious to the usual ways of stopping meteors, NASA and Space Force must put their heads together to solve hell from raining down upon them.

items.title: Apoy Sa Ibabaw, Apoy Sa Ilalim
items.overview: A rice cake vendor who saves the life of a man who has amnesia. As the two get closer and fall in love the man’s fiancée finds him.

items.title: Hive
items.overview: A strict, anxious teenager loses the child she’s babysitting and must brave a sinister force hiding in plain sight among the children in the playground. As her world unravels and her grip on reality starts to slip, she must outwit a world where nothing is as it seems to make it out alive.

items.title: The Whisper Man
items.overview: When his young son vanishes, a widower enlists help from his estranged father, a retired detective who put away the serial killer now linked to the case.

items.title: Nando Between Two Worlds - A Sintonia Film
items.overview: Caught between family life and his obligations to the criminal underworld, Nando faces an impossible choice about where his true loyalties lie.

items.title: Spa Weekend
items.overview: Four lifelong friends realize that somewhere between careers, relationships, families, and everyday responsibilities, they’ve forgotten how to take care of themselves and each other. Burned out and overdue for a break, the women escape to a luxury spa retreat for an unforgettable weekend dedicated to fun, laughter, and a lot of really bad decisions.

items.title: Just Play Dead
items.overview: A criminal mastermind plans to fake his death for insurance money while framing his wife's lover. His wife plots to kill him for real and take it all. Both race to outmanoeuvre each other in a deadly battle of wits.

items.title: Zip Wire
items.overview: When her ground-breaking pharmaceutical discovery is stolen and partner murdered, researcher Amy must face her fear of heights to escape nefarious attackers, with the only path to salvation being a treacherous aerial runway. To outsmart the mysterious hostiles, she has to summon every ounce of courage to protect the world-changing scientific discovery — and herself — before it's too late.

items.title: KATSEYE: Wild Hearts
items.overview: A celebration to the group's new era and the fans who made it possible. Features exclusive behind-the-scenes footage, Eyekons fan videos, and intimate interviews with the members.

items.title: The Secret Woman
items.overview: After discovering she has a family and a shipping empire, a woman with amnesia returns to a wealthy and seemingly perfect past to uncover why she left.

items.title: The Last House
items.overview: A family suddenly sealed inside their home must work together to survive against dwindling resources and the ominous threat keeping them trapped.

items.title: Toxic
items.overview: A powerful drug cartel pulls the strings behind a facade of sun-soaked beaches as a gritty, violent underworld power struggle emerges during the crumbling of Portuguese colonial rule.

items.title: Legend of the White Dragon
items.overview: Forced to hide in the shadows, fugitive hero Erik Reed must clear his name to reunite with his family. Standing in his way is a mysterious villain obsessed with destroying the White Dragon for good.

items.title: The Last Sunrise
items.overview: Ry, a college student with a chronic illness, escapes to Mallorca for the summer with her mother, where she unexpectedly falls for a local and begins to embrace living in the moment. But as her condition worsens and long-hidden family secrets come to light, everything she has found before summer's end is threatened.

items.title: Feed
items.overview: Five social media influencers spend a weekend at a forest retreat but inadvertently awaken and confront the world's first vampire.

items.title: Ice Cream Man
items.overview: An idyllic summer town descends into madness when an ice cream man serves kids sweet delights with horrifying results.

items.title: Khalifa: The Ruler
items.overview: Aamir Ali, a notorious gold smuggling kingpin who inherited his multi-million dollar criminal enterprise from a lineage of gangsters, is drawn into a web of vengeance, legacy and power.

items.title: Hot Spot
items.overview: Set in a near future society ruled by sentient A.I., a private eye investigates a murder case only to discover a rebel group capable of undermining the digital overlord. As the detective's identity slowly unravels, his world enters a state of hypnotic meltdown.

items.title: Papi Ricky: La Película
items.overview: Alicia returns to Chile to introduce her future husband, an eccentric young Spanish hipster who embodies modernity. His arrival causes a family upheaval, and the clash with the conservative Papi Ricky and the irreverent Catrala leads both parents to put aside their old differences and unite around a common goal: stopping their daughter’s wedding.

items.title: THE RIBBON HERO
items.overview: When the monstrous Nergal devastates her kingdom, Princess Sapphire reawakens as the Ribbon Hero and fights to save her new home from the same dark fate.

items.title: Irumudi
items.overview: An alcoholic with a violent past—living peacefully with his daughter beside a waterfall—decides to take Ayyappa Deeksha (a 41-day spiritual vow and period of intense austerity) at her request.

items.title: Beyond Belief
items.overview: An aspiring teenage rock star trains for a marathon after hearing a mysterious voice.

items.title: Rise of the Footsoldier: Retribution
items.overview: Tate battles ruthless mercenaries throughout Ibiza as he avenges his friend's death.  Get ready for the biggest and most action packed film in the successful independent crime saga.

items.title: Paper Flowers
items.overview: Based on a true story, USC graduate Shalin Shah leaves behind the expectations of his Indian-American family and his girlfriend Fiona to serve as a Peace Corps volunteer in Peru. But when a persistent cough leads to a devastating diagnosis of synovial sarcoma, a rare and aggressive cancer, Shalin is forced to return home and confront a future he never anticipated. Surrounded by his family, Fiona, and his closest friends, he begins to reconsider what it means to live with purpose when time can no longer be taken for granted. As Shalin’s perspective deepens, his reflections on gratitude, love, and mortality inspire the essay “Thank You, Cancer,” which is published by HuffPost and goes viral with readers around the world. A devastatingly beautiful story of family, resilience, and the lasting impact of one life, Paper Flowers is a reminder to cherish the people we love and the moments that give life meaning. #SunsetsForShalin

items.title: Shadow on a marble tablet
items.overview: Feature-length experimental film. Accompanied live performances by Grouper in her fall 2026 tour.

items.title: Her in Frame
items.overview: Inspired by the love story of King Bhumibol Adulyadej and Queen Sirikit, the movie follows a young photographer and a textile museum curator who connect through a mysterious vintage photograph.

items.title: Terminator, des machines et des hommes... et une femme
Blue Lock
items.overview: A secret training program is established by the Japan Football Union to scout the world’s greatest striker after several years of defeat for the national team. Three hundred high school players gather at a remote facility to compete in ruthless trials where only one will emerge as the world’s greatest and most egoistic striker. The price of failure is absolute: those eliminated are permanently banned from ever joining the National Team.

items.title: The Drift
items.overview: A survival drama about an ice skater stranded on an ice floe at the Arctic Sea. When the ice floe starts to float towards south and melt, the ice skater must use all means necessary to survive.

items.title: Sad Girlz
items.overview: La Maestra and Paula are the best swimmers on their team and best friends, until an incident at a party changes everything. La Maestra, intense and unstoppable, realises that something in Paula has changed, making her sad. When the truth comes to light, the duo are faced with an impossible decision: Paula wants to keep quiet, while La Maestra wants revenge. Their friendship, previously unbreakable, will be put to the test as never before.

items.title: Root Touch-Up
items.overview: Neda juggles her busy hair salon, two small children, and her husband Antonio, who keeps losing the family’s savings on crypto schemes. When she discovers she is expecting a third child, she decides to terminate the pregnancy.

items.title: Yellow Eyes
items.overview: A young couple inherits a house containing a mysterious relic that hosts the spirit of a powerful demon, and the wife of the man it possesses must find an exorcist to save him.

items.title: Insecta
items.overview: A celebrated horror novelist returns to an isolated estate to say goodbye to her dying father, only to discover that the monstrous imaginary insect that tormented her childhood may have been real all along.

items.title: Yo, Narciso
items.overview: Rocío Flores is a sociologist writing a book about modern narcissism. For her investigation, she acts as the patient of Máximo Rey, a charismatic and egocentric plastic surgeon, triggering a series of hilarious scenarios.

items.title: The Journey to Gyeong-ju
items.overview: Eight years ago, the youngest daughter, Gyeong-ju, disappeared during a school field trip to Gyeongju and never came home alive.  On what would have been her birthday, her mother Ok-sil and her three daughters—Jang-ju, Young-ju, and Dong-ju—put on matching family T-shirts and set off for Gyeongju, the place where Gyeong-ju vanished, in what appears to be a family trip to honor her memory. But beneath the cheerful façade lies a deadly secret. In the trunk of their van is a bound and unconscious man zipped inside a plastic bag.

items.title: The Blessing
items.overview: Several people have barricaded themselves inside a bar. The music must never stop, otherwise something terrible could happen.

items.title: El método
items.overview: A struggling actor is cast to play a legendary film star and must isolate himself in the actor's mansion to undergo an extreme method-acting process. As he digs into the role, he uncovers clues surrounding a mysterious death-forcing him to question the man he is becoming and how far he's willing to go to expose the truth.

items.title: Cairn
items.overview: Filmed across 100 miles of Scottish wilderness, three estranged friends trek through the Highlands, where guilt, conflict and buried grief force them to confront what they’ve been running from.

items.title: Oradour
items.overview: Five days before the massacre at Oradour-sur-Glane, Philippe Gerbier, an officer in the Free French Forces, is parachuted in near the village. He is to lead a mission for the Resistance in preparation for the D-Day landings. There, he is reunited with Marie, his childhood sweetheart.

items.title: Ever After
items.overview: A group of girlfriends arrive at a forest lodge to celebrate, but things take a horrific turn as they realize that the forest is home to bloodthirsty lunatics who perceive themselves to be characters from classic fairy tales.

items.title: No Worries
items.overview: A man addicted to people-pleasing unravels limb by limb in a grotesque, darkly comic descent into nothingness.
